notes.title: SMALL UPDATE: AVAILABLE FOR MAC / WE'RE WORKING ON VIVE
notes.notes:
The[b] Mac version[/b] of DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE is already available! So Mac people can already enjoy the game.

[b]About Vive,[/b] we are working on it, but it is taking us time because the version of the graphics engine we use (Unreal Engine) is giving us problems. Still, we hope to have it ready asap!

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE improved version available NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571888/0906a419f946799ce5604cc9f7de4ae3c9aa0556.png[/img]

Hello cultists!

A few months ago we came up with the idea of making a shorter game, while we keep developing DESOLATIUM, in order to make the wait more bearable. And this is how [b]DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE[/b] was born.

It was at first published on Steam for our backers to try it and thanks to their feedback, we developed a new and [b]improved version[/b].

[h1]WHAT’S NEW?[/h1]

[list]
[*] Better Sound
[*] Improved quality of videos
[*] Redesigned notes and dialoges
[*] Steam Achievements!
[/list]

This new version of DESOLATIUM: PROLOGUE is [b]available for everyone[/b]!

We would love to [b]read your opinions[/b], in order to keep moving forward and to give you the best possible experience with the final game, DESOLATIUM.

If you still haven’t played, get ready to experience this prologue! If you already have, you can [b]leave your review[/b], that helps us a lot! But remember that, for now, [b]Cthulhu [/b]is on our side 🐙
